description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for verifying git submodule behaviors when the submodule is not properly initialized or has been moved or removed. It includes functions for adding files to repositories, committing, and various test scenarios with expected outputs.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a git repository, commits them with a message indicating the file names, and returns the short hash of the latest commit.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a git commit with a message indicating the files committed.
